description: Native Enyo NNUE experiment: scratch Enyo-layout Bullet training directly from the proven Stockfish NNUE binpack, with no Berserk initialization.
hypothesis: The existing-weight lane is saturated and recent target/objective repairs still move only dense head tensors. A native Enyo net needs a broader proven data source than Enyo self-play; train from scratch on the SF binpack with Bullet and gate saved checkpoints.
gates: checkpoint sweep must show move-gate progress toward the current reference
static validation is a rejection filter, not proof
failure-suite replay must not introduce an unacceptable tail
SPRT only if cheap gates are clean

validation.next: run native SF-binpack scratch preflight and checkpoint sweep; continue only if move-gate progress is materially better than prior Enyo-selfplay scratch nets
